title: Brew coffee from whole beans (weigh, grind, brew)
summary: Person is weighing whole coffee beans (Eight O'Clock) on a kitchen scale in a bowl, likely to grind and brew a cup of coffee, possibly following a recipe on a tablet.

nodes.name: Gather mug and coffee gear
nodes.instruction_novice: Grab a clean mug, your coffee bag, grinder, and brewer. Set them on the counter.
nodes.end_state: Mug, coffee bag, scale, and brewer sit on the counter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Gather mug and coffee gear?

nodes.name: Place bowl on scale and tare
nodes.instruction_novice: Set an empty bowl on the scale. Press the tare button so it reads zero.
nodes.end_state: Empty bowl on scale with display showing 0.

checks.question: Is this step done: Place bowl on scale and tare?

nodes.name: Weigh out the coffee beans
nodes.instruction_novice: Add beans a few at a time until you reach the target weight. About 15 to 20 grams makes one cup.
nodes.end_state: Beans in bowl with scale showing the target weight.

checks.question: Is this step done: Weigh out the coffee beans?

nodes.name: Close and store the coffee bag
nodes.instruction_novice: Roll the bag top down and seal it. This keeps the remaining beans fresh.
nodes.end_state: Coffee bag is rolled closed and set aside.

checks.question: Is this step done: Close and store the coffee bag?

nodes.name: Heat the water
nodes.instruction_novice: Fill a kettle with fresh water and bring it to a boil. Let it rest about 30 seconds off the boil.

checks.question: Is this step done: Heat the water?

nodes.name: Grind the beans
nodes.instruction_novice: Pour the beans into the grinder and grind to a medium texture, like coarse sand.
nodes.end_state: Ground coffee in the grinder cup, no whole beans left.

checks.question: Is this step done: Grind the beans?

nodes.name: Load grounds into brewer
nodes.instruction_novice: Put a filter in the brewer and add the grounds. Shake gently to level them.
nodes.end_state: Leveled coffee grounds in a filter over the mug.

checks.question: Is this step done: Load grounds into brewer?

nodes.name: Bloom the grounds
nodes.instruction_novice: Pour just enough hot water to wet all the grounds. Wait about 30 seconds.
nodes.end_state: Grounds are wet and puffed up.

checks.question: Is this step done: Bloom the grounds?

nodes.name: Pour remaining water slowly
nodes.instruction_novice: Pour the rest of the water slowly in circles. Aim for about 16 times the coffee weight.
nodes.end_state: Water has been added and is dripping through into the mug.

checks.question: Is this step done: Pour remaining water slowly?

nodes.name: Remove brewer and discard grounds
nodes.instruction_novice: When dripping stops, lift off the brewer. Throw away the filter and grounds.
nodes.end_state: Mug full of brewed coffee; brewer removed.

checks.question: Is this step done: Remove brewer and discard grounds?

nodes.name: Add milk or sugar and serve
nodes.instruction_novice: Add milk or sugar if you like, and stir. Enjoy your coffee.
nodes.end_state: Finished cup of coffee ready to drink.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add milk or sugar and serve?
